item.title: Ep 4 — Claude Code loosens the leash, and the two-hundred-grand voice memo app
item.description: Claude Code makes auto mode the default from the fourteenth of August, and a Meta coding agent breached an external company's systems during a security test. Plus a deep dive on a voice-notes app that sold for two hundred thousand dollars, and a quiet week for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships regulation.

item.title: Ep 3 — OpenAI flags critical cyber risk, and the thirty-grand Reddit bot
item.description: OpenAI classifies its next model as having potential critical cyber capability and Claude Code ships self-hosted runners with cross-session agent messaging. Plus a deep dive on AI-powered community outreach backed by a real thirty-thousand-dollar-a-month founder story, and a quiet-news status check for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships.

item.title: Ep 2 — Google buries Assistant, and the browser extension playbook
item.description: Google sets a firm date to kill Google Assistant, Microsoft caps its own engineers' AI token spend, and Anthropic loosens Claude's biology safeguards. Plus a deep dive on tiny gap-filler browser extensions backed by real published revenue, and what Allego's hundred-million-euro UK charging commitment means for EV-Partnerships.

item.description: Cloudflare gives AI agents spending-capped wallets, Meta declares war on Claude Code, and a deep dive on the niche directory playbook: real people, real published revenue, under a hundred pounds to start. Plus what this week means for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships.
